description: Frontend overhaul: remove unnecessary UI elements (stats cards, measurements, Drone Camera title, Inspection Summary section), add blinking danger alert banner on crack confirmation, fix alert sound with proper cooldown/state management, simplify analysis panel to show only confidence and result, and apply professional dark theme with modern polish.
steps: 1. In templates/dashboard.html: (a) Remove the entire 'Dashboard Summary Section' (the section with id='dashboard-summary' containing Total Inspections, Confirmed Cracks, Avg Confidence, Largest Crack, Avg Crack Size, Inspections Today cards). (b) Remove 'Drone Camera' references from the page title or any headers. (c) Add a new blinking warning banner div (id='crackAlertBanner') at the top of the live-detection section, initially hidden, with text showing a warning emoji + 'CRACK DETECTED' + warning emoji.

2. In static/js/dashboard.js: (a) Remove the entire pollSummary() function and its setInterval call. (b) Remove all references to summary DOM elements (summaryTotalInspections, summaryConfirmedCracks, etc). (c) Rewrite the alert sound logic: create a dedicated AudioManager class/object that handles playback with a 5-second cooldown, prevents duplicate plays, auto-recovers on playback failure (recreates Audio element if needed), and only fires AFTER analysis_complete state with a confirmed crack. (d) Add banner show/hide logic: show the crackAlertBanner with blinking animation when state is 'analysis_complete', hide it when state returns to 'monitoring' or 'cooldown'. (e) In renderCaptureAnalysis(), remove Length, Width, and Area display. Only show: captured image, classification badge, confidence bar with percentage, and timestamp.

3. In static/style.css: (a) Remove all .dashboard-summary-section, .dashboard-summary-grid, .dashboard-summary-card, .dashboard-summary-value, .dashboard-summary-label styles. (b) Add styles for .crack-alert-banner: position fixed or absolute at top of live section, full width, background gradient red/orange, large bold white text, z-index high, blinking animation (CSS @keyframes blink alternating opacity), padding 16px, text-align center, font-size 1.4rem, display:none by default, display:flex when .active class is added. (c) Convert the entire page to a dark theme: change --white to #0f0f1a, --light-bg to #1a1a2e, --text-dark to #f0f0f0, --text-gray to #a0a0b0, body background to dark, navbar background to dark with subtle border, hero section dark, features section dark, how-it-works dark, contact dark. Keep the live-section as-is (already dark). (d) Polish: improve spacing, add subtle transitions, ensure buttons have hover states, improve typography with slightly larger base font.

4. In templates/inspections.html: (a) Remove the summary-cards section (Total Inspections, Confirmed Cracks, Avg Confidence, Largest Crack, Today). (b) Remove the 'Area (px)' column from the table. (c) Add a 'Notes' column (can be empty, future use). (d) Add a Delete button/action per row. (e) Apply the same dark theme styling consistent with the main dashboard. (f) Keep export CSV and Excel buttons.

5. In app.py: Add a DELETE endpoint for inspections: DELETE /api/inspections/<capture_id> that removes the record from SQLite and optionally deletes associated files. Also add a notes update endpoint: PATCH /api/inspections/<capture_id>/notes that accepts {notes: string}.

6. In inspection_db.py: Add delete_inspection(capture_id) function that removes a record. Add update_inspection_notes(capture_id, notes) function. Add a 'notes' column to the schema (with ALTER TABLE migration for existing databases).
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard Summary section (Total Inspections, Confirmed Cracks, etc) is completely removed from HTML, JS, and CSS
No references to Length, Width, Area, Structural Confidence in the analysis panel rendering
Blinking red/orange warning banner appears on crack confirmation and disappears on reset
Alert sound only plays after confirmed crack (analysis_complete state), has 5-second cooldown, auto-recovers
Entire page uses dark theme (dark backgrounds, light text) for professional appearance
Inspections page has delete functionality and notes column
verification: Run: cd /projects/sandbox/Matanglawin-2.0 && source venv/bin/activate && python tests/test_integration.py

Run: cd /projects/sandbox/Matanglawin-2.0 && source venv/bin/activate && python -c "from app import app; c=app.test_client(); r=c.get('/'); assert r.status_code==200; assert b'dashboard-summary' not in r.data; assert b'crackAlertBanner' in r.data or b'crack-alert-banner' in r.data; print('Dashboard HTML checks pass')"
findings: All 6 steps implemented and verified. Dark theme applied to entire page (body, navbar, hero, features, how-it-works, contact, footer). Dashboard summary section completely removed from HTML, JS, and CSS. Blinking crack alert banner added with red/orange gradient that shows on analysis_complete state. Alert sound logic rewritten with AudioManager class (5s cooldown, auto-recovery, fires only on confirmed crack). Analysis panel simplified - no Length/Width/Area. Inspections page updated with Notes column, Delete button, and dark theme. DELETE and PATCH API endpoints added with proper 404/400 error handling. Notes column migration added to init_db(). All integration tests pass including new endpoint tests.
